item.title: Benedict Cua marks Chinese New Year with cute photos with son Aleck
item.description: Benedict Cua welcomed the Year of the Fire Horse with his family, and he marked this year's Chinese New Year with the cutest photos with his son Aleck. The social media content creator shared on Instagram photos from their family's Chinese New Year photoshoot, including snaps of him and Aleck, whom they fondly call Baobao. “Happy [Chinese New Year]!! Complete, finally!” Benedict wrote in the caption.
